latest.label: Back to latest
latest.title: Clear the selected moment and show the latest data

column.cpuTitle: Average over the recording interval (usually 5 seconds)

empty.offHint: Once turned on in Settings, Argus records every 5 seconds, or at the minimized or tray refresh rate when that is slower.
empty.hint: Argus records every 5 seconds while running, or at the minimized or tray refresh rate when that is slower, and keeps 7 days.

hint.pick: Click any moment on the charts to see the processes at that time
hint.move: Press ← → on the charts to step through time, Esc to return to the latest

note: Records the top processes by CPU, memory, I/O, GPU and network every 5 seconds (or at the minimized or tray refresh rate when that is slower) and keeps them for 7 days.
off: History recording is off; no new data is being recorded. <link>Open Settings</link>
instanceUnavailable: The recorded instance of {name} (PID {pid}) has exited or its identity cannot be confirmed.
cpuSummary: CPU average {average}%, peak {peak}%; peak frame: {time}. Process readings are frame averages and do not establish the cause of a brief peak.

coverage.help: Only valid samples are averaged; partial records lack some samples or devices. Only recorded reasons are shown. An unavailable source may have no known reason. “?” marks legacy data without availability.

watch.title: Process observation
watch.empty: Choose “Watch this instance” in the details of a single process to record memory even below the top list.
watch.note: This instance only; up to 1 hour, 720 points and 1 MiB. Samples are usually 5 seconds apart; slower background sampling may leave gaps. Working set growth alone does not prove a memory leak. Stop keeps data; Delete stops and removes this recording.

error.unavailable: The sampler did not reply in time. The outcome is unknown; check recording status before retrying.
error.identity: The selected instance could not be confirmed. Refresh and try again.
error.access: This instance cannot be read with current permissions.
error.existing: An observation already exists. Stop and delete it before starting another.
error.storage: The recording could not be read or written. Recording has stopped.
error.invalid: The recording is damaged or uses an unsupported format. It can be deleted.

watch.runSummary: Showing {shown}/{total} launches; {points} saved points in this launch
watch.programNote: Current and future launches at this image path are recorded separately. Up to 7 days, 131072 points and 9 MiB; the first limit reached removes oldest data. Up to 512 concurrent instances. The list shows the latest 256 launches; each page shows up to 1000 saved points plus gap markers. Earlier points remain browsable. Samples are usually 5 seconds apart; slower sampling leaves gaps. Working set growth does not prove a leak. Stop keeps data; Delete removes it. Restarting Argus does not resume recording.
watch.damaged: Some stored records failed integrity checks; missing intervals remain gaps.
watch.unconfirmed: Could not confirm {count} same-named instances; retrying once per minute.

interval.title: Interval analysis
interval.chooseEnd: Choose another moment, then select “End at this frame”.
interval.invalid: Choose a valid interval of up to 7 days.
interval.coverage: Saved frames {recorded}/{expected}; missing {missing}; nominal step {step} s.
interval.leaders: Ranked by sum of saved CPU frame means: {shown}/{total} instances
interval.process: CPU mean while listed {average}%, peak frame mean {peak}%; listed in {observed}/{recorded} saved frames; private working set peak {memory}.
interval.incomplete: Some files, frames or process entries could not be used; this analysis is incomplete.
interval.note: Means use saved valid frames only. The system CPU peak is a recorded sample peak; process peaks are peaks of frame means. A process absent from the top list is unknown, never zero. Ranking uses the sum of saved frame means, not measured CPU time, and does not establish a cause. Legacy entries without identity are not merged into launches. This view analyses CPU and private working set peaks; process I/O is not physical disk traffic.
interval.coverageFrames: Valid frames {valid}/{total}; partial sources {partial}; legacy frames without availability data {legacy}.
interval.resourceNote: Source means are weighted by saved valid sample counts. Gaps and unknown legacy availability are not zeros. ≥ marks a known subset of sources. Resource peaks are peaks of valid frame means. Process memory records only private working set peaks; other process rankings use sums of saved frame means, not device time or byte totals. System disk and process I/O are different counters; system disk traffic is not assigned to a process. Simultaneous changes across sources do not establish a cause.
interval.gpuCaveat: Process GPU readings reflect the busiest engine at sampling time. Engine IDs were not stored, so a shared engine between system and process readings cannot be confirmed.
interval.memoryCaveat: The system reading is physical memory; process rows show private working set peaks. Row peaks may occur at different times, so their sum is not RAM usage at one moment.
interval.memoryNote: System memory is averaged over saved valid frames; the format does not store its original sample counts. Missing frames are not zeros, and process memory means are not inferred from peaks.
interval.observationCoverage: Showing {shown}/{total} instances; {selected} points in this interval / {saved} points retained; nominal step {step} s.
interval.observationMemory: {metric}: saved-point mean {average}, peak {peak}; valid points {valid}, points without readings {missing}.
interval.observationMarkers: Selected records: {from} to {to}; gap markers {gaps}, unrecorded nominal sample slots {missing}, terminal markers {terminal}.
interval.observationEmpty: No retained observation points in this interval.
interval.observationIncomplete: Unreadable files {unreadable}, damaged files {damaged}, expired points {expired}; omitted points {omittedPoints}, omitted instances {omittedRuns}.
interval.observationNote: Means use saved valid points, not time-weighted memory. Gap and terminal markers are not zeros. Retention is limited by age and capacity; the first and last points do not establish continuous coverage. Markers describe recorded events, not whether a process is alive now. Instance memory is separate from system memory and is not added to it.

report.title: Local interval report
report.frozen: This preview is a fixed snapshot. The saved file will contain exactly the text below. Generating another preview invalidates this one.
report.privacy: Reports use instance aliases and omit process names, PIDs, creation times, image paths, accounts, host addresses and command lines. Processing stays on this computer; saving does not send the file.
report.cpuNote: The system CPU peak is a saved sample peak; its time is the start of the containing frame. Process CPU peaks are peaks of frame means. Legacy rows without instance identity receive separate aliases per frame. Means are not CPU time, and correlation does not establish a cause.
report.reasons: Missing reason bits: 1 source unavailable, 2 access denied, 4 stale, 8 awaiting baseline. Zero does not establish complete coverage.
report.timing: All times are UTC. The interval end is excluded; instance bounds are actual saved points. History nominal step {step} ms; observation nominal step {sample} ms. Values have up to 6 decimal places.
report.extent: History frames {recorded}/{expected}, missing {missing}, gap spans {gaps}; tracked instances {identities}, omitted entries {omitted}, unreadable files {unreadable}, incomplete files {incomplete}, invalid frames {invalid}.
report.observationExtent: Observation retention bounds {from} to {to}; retained points {saved}, selected {selected}; instances shown {shown}/{total}; unreadable files {unreadable}, damaged {damaged}, expired points {expired}, omitted points {omittedPoints}, omitted instances {omittedRuns}.
report.sourceCoverage: Valid frames {valid}/{total}, partial-source frames {partial}, unknown legacy frames {legacy}, invalid frames {invalid}; valid samples {samples}/{expected}, missing reason bits {reasons}.
report.listed: Listed in {count}/{total} saved frames; peak only, no saved mean.
report.observationCoverage: Valid points {valid}, points without readings {missing}; gap markers {gaps}, unrecorded nominal slots {slots}, terminal markers {terminal}.

error.invalid: A report could not be generated for this interval.
error.storage: The local report could not be prepared or saved.
error.stale: This preview expired. Generate a new preview before saving.
error.tooLarge: The report exceeds the size limit. Choose a shorter interval.
